question: Can seedream5_flash paint a brand-new thing the reader asks for, live, in the book's object style, on flat magenta paper, so it cuts out cleanly in Node (no Python) and reads at a glance in the headset?
why: The AI Storyteller's 'anything appears' pillar (owner, Nov 14): when the story needs something that isn't in the library, the backend paints it in about 30 s while a character goes to fetch it. This run proves the recipe before any live painting is allowed.
sameAcrossJobs: seedream5_flash, 1024:1024, Figure 1 is the approved kite (run 006) composited on flat magenta paper as the style reference; the same prompt template with only the thing's description changed.
decideBy: Each image cuts out in backend/src/storyteller/cutout.ts into exactly one piece, with its alpha coverage between 4% and 60% of the image and no paint touching the border.
Each reads at a glance as what was asked, in the cast's watercolour-and-pencil style, beside the kite.
Seconds and credits per image, from the manifest: the live budget is 2 credits and about 30 s.
learnEvenIfRejected: Whether flash holds the style from one reference, how often the paint touches the border, and the real time per image, which decide the live painter's caps and its 'couldn't find it' rate.
reusableOutput: The prompt template becomes the live painter's recipe in backend/src/storyteller/paint.ts. The images are throwaway tests, not product assets.

jobs.prompt: Paint one new thing in exactly the painting style of Figure 1, as a single separate storybook object: a small round blue-glazed teapot with a chipped spout and a dented lid. The object alone, centered, upright, about half the height of the image. Leave a wide margin of empty paper on all four sides, with nothing touching the edge of the image. Its silhouette has a clean hard edge traced with a fine graphite pencil outline. No cast shadows on the paper. Hand-painted traditional watercolor with a fine graphite pencil outline, from a vintage natural history picture book. Soft pigment washes, visible paper grain, gentle edges. Natural, believable, not a cartoon. On plain flat solid vivid magenta paper, one even color. No pink or purple on the object. No scenery, no text, no kite.
